name: deps
description: An AI-powered dependabot that answers the question dependabot cannot: is this update worth taking? Builds a CLAUDE_DEPS.md profile of what your project actually consumes from each library — including C++ deps that Renovate ignores, like URL-pinned FetchContent archives and pkg-config system libraries — then intersects upstream release notes with your real API surface and ranks the updates. Can apply a bump, re-hash the archive, and verify the build.
